The Dragonblight Flame Keeper welcomes visitors to honor the Horde festival flame. The Keeper urges honoring fires in Horde lands and desecrating Alliance fires.
High-Oracle Soo-roo speaks of a visit and urges Little Roo not to forget what they learn from their new friend, saying that Little Roo has a great future ahead.
Elder Kekek is a Frenzyheart elder who tells young Kekek to grow strong and hopes he will lead the Frenzyheart back to their old home, away from the “big-tongue babies.”
A playful figure in Snowfall Glade, this playmate warns “Better watch out!” and boasts, “Got you good!”

The Lich King derides an effort to fulfill Mograine's task as predictable and refuses to let it go unopposed. He threatens two people with suffering and eternal unrest, comparing their fate to a father's suffering, then dismisses a foe with a curt wish to die well.
A wretched undead ghoul that rises already reborn through Rebirth.

Kalecgos is an ambassador of the Blue Dragonflight who seeks to salvage its pride while acknowledging the mistrust his brethren have earned. He rejects blaming mortals for all of Azeroth's troubles. Wary that prismatic blades could be turned against dragons as an earlier weapon was, he questions Krasus's assistance but yields to his queen and promises to watch closely. He grieves Sindragosa's suffering and wishes her peace.

place_records.text: You are in Dragonblight, a land in Northrend where Alliance and Horde both hold settlements. The Alliance keeps Stars' Rest, Fordragon Hold and Wintergarde Keep, the Horde keeps Agmar's Hammer and Venomspite, and Moa'ki Harbor belongs to neither side. The main dangers are undead such as Hungering Dead and wretched ghouls, Anub'ar nerubians, wolvar packs, and mage hunters of the blue dragonflight.

You are in Westwind Refugee Camp, a Horde camp on the western border of Dragonblight. Taunka survivors of the Scourge gather here, and the tauren Emissary Brighthoof works to bring them into the Horde. Horde guards Roh'kill and Tor'zin are still recovering from an Anub'ar ambush on an arms caravan.

You are in Moa'ki Harbor, a Tuskarr and Kalu'ak fishing harbor on the Dragonblight coast that neither side holds. Elder Ko'nani, chieftain of the Dragonblight Kalu'ak, is struggling to protect his people's stores from wolvar raids. The old fisherman Tua'kea fears that his sea enemy Tu'u'gwar has returned.

You are in Indu'le Village, a Kalu'ak village in Dragonblight struck by a surge of magic from the lake. Most of its people died at once, and those who survived were driven mad. Deranged villagers, Indu'le warriors and mystics still roam its ruins.

You are in Snowfall Glade, a den of wolvar north of Moa'ki Harbor. Wolvar reavers, den mothers and shamans hold the glade, and Loguhn leads them as alpha male. Trapper Mau'i wants Snowfall pups captured so the wolvar can survive alongside the Tuskarr.

You are in Moonrest Gardens, the ruined resting place of the Highborne elves in Dragonblight. Mage hunters and surge needle sorcerers hold the ruins, and the spirit Ethenial Moonshadow demands vengeance for the destruction there. Arcanimus, a giant device in the sky, feeds on the spirits of the dead.

You are in Stars' Rest, an Alliance settlement in Dragonblight with a hippogryph master, Palena Silvercloud. The Image of Archmage Modera, a Kirin Tor projection, studies the ley-line power redirected around Moonrest Gardens. Sarendryana urges that those who can be restored be saved, because the blue dragonflight's magic is harming the Lothalor Ancients.

You are in Lothalor Woodlands, a forest in Dragonblight where Lothalor Ancients stand. Some of the ancients have been corrupted, and arcane wyrms and mage hunters roam the trees. A Lothalor Ancient can be strengthened with Bark of the Walkers, which a Woodlands Walker may give away.

You are in Icemist Village, the former taunka capital in Dragonblight, now held by the Scourge and Anub'ar. Anub'ar slayers and cultists are the dangers here. Roanauk Icemist, High Chieftain of the Taunka, is held in Icemist's Prison, and his son Banthok searches the village for him.

You are in Agmar's Hammer, the Horde stronghold in Dragonblight, where Overlord Agmar commands the Kor'kron. Kor'kron Wing Commander Valnok Windrager coordinates air attacks on the Anub'ar threat from here. Shadowy tormentors and dragonbone condors are the dangers around it.

You are in Lake Indu'le, a lake in Dragonblight with a ley-line focus beneath its water. Corrupted ragers and Indu'le fishermen attack along the shore. The corpse of Mage-Commander Evenstar, who led the mage hunters here, lies among his forces, apparently slain by elementals after they summoned the focus.

You are in Obsidian Dragonshrine, a dragon shrine in Dragonblight. Serinar, a black dragon whose bones the Cult of the Damned exploits, despises the cult and shows it no mercy. Smoldering skeletons and Burning Depths necrolytes are the dangers here.

You are in Ruby Dragonshrine, a dragon shrine in Dragonblight. Vargastrasz, a red dragon, defends it as the Scourge turns fallen red wyrms into emberwyrms. Frigid necromancers and geists roam the shrine.

You are in Fordragon Hold, an Alliance hold in Dragonblight. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon leads the Alliance here against the Scourge at Angrathar, and he will not defile dragons' bones without Alexstrasza's permission. Frost wyrms strafe the field from overhead, and Angrathar geists are the dangers on the ground. A flight master and a spirit healer serve the hold.

You are in Kor'kron Vanguard, a place in Dragonblight where Alliance and Horde both have people. Saurfang the Younger readies the Kor'kron Vanguard for battle at the Wrathgate beside Highlord Fordragon. Frost wyrms strafing from above keep both sides from advancing on the gate. Numo Spiritbreeze, a Horde wind rider master, offers fast air travel.
You are in The Court of Skulls, an area of Dragonblight where Fordragon sentinels hold their position. Scourge abominations, gargoyles and constructs are the dangers here, including plague eruptors.

You are in Angrathar the Wrathgate, a battlefield in Dragonblight. Alexstrasza, Queen of the Dragons, speaks here in the aftermath and says the fallen paladin's fate must remain undiscovered for now. Her consort Korialstrasz is with her. Scourge abominations, gargoyles and constructs still haunt the field.
You are in Galakrond's Rest, part of Dragonblight. Wastes scavengers are the most common danger here, with rotting storm giants and a reanimated frost wyrm.

You are in the Bronze Dragonshrine, a shrine in Dragonblight. Nozdormu, the Lord of Time, is a dragonkin found here. Bronze shrine wardens fight intruders with Sand Breath and Stop Time. Infinite eradicators and timebreakers are the dangers.
You are in The Mirror of Dawn, a part of Dragonblight. Ice revenants are the main danger here, with iceshatters, and arctic clouds, which are gas clouds, are also found in the area.

You are in Wintergarde Keep, an Alliance keep in Dragonblight under siege by the Scourge. High Commander Halford Wyrmbane of the 7th Legion directs rescue efforts as the lower village falls. Vengeful geists and dreadbone constructs roam the ruins, and a necrolord has got into the town crypt. The keep has a flight master, an inn and a stable master.

You are in the Emerald Dragonshrine, a shrine in Dragonblight. Nishera the Garden Keeper tends Ysera's garden and seeks to restore the shrine's balance amid the Emerald Nightmare's confusion. She warns that the garden can deceive. Emerald lashers and skytalons are the dangers, and an immense skytalon named Alystros guards the air from the south end.

You are in New Hearthglen, a village in Dragonblight that the Scarlet Onslaught holds. Captured Horde prisoners are held here, among them Deathguard Schneider and Chancellor Amai. Venomspite spy Agent Skully works here undercover as an Onslaught caretaker. Onslaught footmen, raven priests and warhorses are the dangers.
You are in Crusader's Landing, a place in Dragonblight where Onslaught deckhands are the most common danger, with Onslaught warhorses and footmen. Captain Shely is among the Onslaught forces here.
You are in the Azure Dragonshrine, a shrine in Dragonblight. Focus wizards and Dragonblight mage hunters are the most common dangers, with azure drakes and azure dragons also here.

You are in Path of the Titans, a stretch of Dragonblight. Jotun the Curse Bearer, a giant, is found here, and Wyrmrest Temple drakes and Wyrmrest Guardians, high-ranking dragonkin, fight with Flame Breath. Azure drakes and Dragonblight mage hunters are the dangers here.

You are in The Forgotten Shore, a shore of Dragonblight. Forgotten peasants, riflemen, footmen, knights and captains roam it in numbers, and arctic grizzly cubs prowl the edges. A wild snowfall elk lives here too and will answer a nearby threat with a Puncture attack.

You are in Venomspite, a Horde stronghold in Dragonblight with an inn, repairs and a stable. Chief Plaguebringer Middleton works here on a blight to use against the Scourge, and High Executor Wroth leads the Hand of Vengeance here as the Horde fights the Scarlet Onslaught from this post.

You are in The Crystal Vice, a canyon in Dragonblight that serves as a refuge from dragons. Ko'char the Unbreakable welcomes visitors but warns that goblins cannot be trusted, and the researcher Zort studies the jormungar that have been attacking the giants from the cavern below. Those worms are led by a spawnmother called Rattlebore.

You are in The Carrion Fields, a battlefield in Dragonblight where Alliance soldiers fight the Scourge, and a spirit healer is here. Mindless ghouls, Hungering Dead, Dreadbone Invaders and plague wagons roam the fields. Ambo Cash of the 7th Legion directs the offensive from the Wintergarde Mausoleum and worries about his soldiers.

You are in Onslaught Base Camp, an Onslaught camp in Dragonblight. Onslaught infantry, masons and bloodhounds occupy it. Onslaught Commander Iustus and Scarlet Highlord Daion are the notable enemies here.

You are in Thorson's Post, an Alliance post in Dragonblight. Duke August Foehammer of the 7th Legion commands here, and reinforcements heading east from Wintergarde report to him as the campaign against the Scourge moves on.

You are in Light's Trust, a former Drakkari temple in Dragonblight. Argent Crusaders keep it, and Crusader Valus urges Horde and Alliance to unite against the Lich King. He sends aid to Light's Breach in Zul'Drak, where the Scourge are pushing to take the region.
You are in Scarlet Point, an Onslaught post in Dragonblight. Onslaught infantry, masons, death knights and raven archons are the dangers here, and Scarlet Highlord Daion is the most notable of them.

You are in Jintha'kalar, a ruined Drakkari city in Dragonblight. Scourge necromancers here have turned the surviving Drakkari trolls into their servants, and tormented Drakkari, hulking atrocities and decrepit necromancers roam the ruins. Overseer Deathgaze is the most notable.
You are in Glittering Strand, a shore in Dragonblight. Focus wizards, moonrest stalkers and Dragonblight mage hunters roam it, and Captain Emmy Malin is among the notable enemies.

You are in Dragon's Fall, a Horde camp of Darkspear trolls in Dragonblight. Rokhan, a Darkspear dragon hunter, faces the Scourge frostwyrm Sarathstra and can call the dragon down. Snobolds have raided the camp and stolen supplies, and Kontokanis sends help to hunt them.

You are in Coldwind Heights, a windswept highland in Dragonblight with no settlement of either side. Crystalline ice elementals and giants roam its slopes, and Jormungar feeders wander the snow. Coldwind witches and huntresses are a constant danger, and harpies have been seen in its back country. Arctic rams gore intruders that threaten them.

You are in Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight, where Argent Crusade paladins and priestesses serve beside a spirit healer. Paladin Orik Trueheart investigates the restless dead haunting the Forgotten Shore, believing they were once Alliance soldiers. Priestess Tilda Darathan recruits able soldiers for the Crusade's fight against the Lich King. Blighted elks are the local danger.

You are in Eldritch Heights in Dragonblight, a wild stretch with no settlement of either side. Bloodpaw shamans, warriors and marauders roam it, including High Shaman Bloodpaw. Snowfall elks graze the region and fight back with a puncture attack when threatened.

You are in the 7th Legion Front, an Alliance front in Dragonblight. Legion Commander Tyralion directs the effort to bring down Icestorm, a frostwyrm, and Wyrmbait draws her close enough for the soldiers to strike. Wyrm hunters and clerics serve among the 7th Legion's forces here, which fight the Scourge's frostwyrms.

You are in The Dragon Wastes, where Wyrmrest Temple stands in Dragonblight. It offers flight, an inn and a stable. Queen Alexstrasza the Life-Binder rules at Wyrmrest Temple, and Lauriel Trueblade and Golluck Rockfist speak for the Alliance and Horde there. Malygos's blue dragons threaten the temple, while dragonbone condors and snowplain zealots roam the wastes.

You are in Nozzlerust Post in northern Dragonblight, a goblin supply post. Narf protects the operation against undead and harpies that disrupt the work. Xink supplies ore, lumber and Jormungar meat. Zivlix is an inventive but unreliable bomb maker, and Troz is a merchant who sells goods and offers repairs.

You are in Coldwind Pass, a route into Dragonblight from the Borean Tundra where Horde taunka wait for evacuees. Wartook Iceborn waits at the Transborea crossing, where evacuees arrive after a perilous journey across the tundra. Wartook Iceborn warns that the Scourge raises dead taunka to attack caravans, and frozen elementals roam the pass.

You are in Wyrmrest Temple, a dragon temple in Dragonblight that neither side holds. Queen Alexstrasza, the Queen of the Dragons, is here, with Tariolstrasz the steward directing visitors and Lord Afrasastrasz commanding the defenses. Azure drakes and dragons of Malygos's blue flight threaten the temple, and it has an inn and a flight master.

You are in Wintergarde Mine, a mine in Dragonblight. Risen miners and defenders still prowl it. Slinkin the Demo-gnome, a 7th Legion gnome, hides here and reports that Scourge miners are extracting saronite for their war machines.
You are in Frostmourne Cavern, a cavern in Dragonblight. Deathbringer revenants and Onslaught infantry haunt it.
You are in Ice Heart Cavern, a cavern in Dragonblight. Jormungar feeders and spawn, crystalline ice giants and rattlebores haunt its depths.

You are in Maw of Neltharion, a cave in Dragonblight where the Cult of the Damned has drawn necromantic runes. Serinar, a black dragon of the brood, despises the cult and shows it no mercy. Burning Depths necromancers and necrolytes, smoldering geists and constructs, and magmawyrms haunt its depths.

You are in Wintergarde Mausoleum, a Scourge-haunted mausoleum in Dragonblight where 7th Legion soldiers of the Alliance fight. Ambo Cash coordinates the offensive here, and Legion Commander Yorik plans to draw the dread lich Thel'zan out of hiding with his phylactery. Mindless ghouls, dreadbone constructs and Naxxramas shades roam the place, and a Scourge tunnel runs beneath it.
